source.title: Pupil fluctuations track rapid changes in adrenergic and cholinergic activity in cortex

confidence_rationale: Included as the instrument-validity anchor for the pupil evidence in this pull, and it cuts both ways. It supports the NA-timescale reading (rapid pupil dilations are tightly tied to phasic activity in noradrenergic cortical axons, which licenses reading phasic pupil as partly phasic NA) and it weakens NA-specificity (sustained dilations track cholinergic axon activity, so pupil is a mixed NA/ACh readout). For MECH-084, which separates the NA 'snap' from the ACh 'trace', the direction is mixed: the phasic/sustained split lines up with the claim's NA-phasic / ACh-sustained division, but it also means pupil-based support can never meet the falsifier's matched-arousal control on its own.
failure_signatures: Pupil diameter tracks cholinergic as well as noradrenergic axon activity, so human pupil-based evidence (de Gee 2017, Krishnamurthy 2017 in this pull) cannot by itself attribute bias reduction or prior down-weighting to NA rather than ACh.
Measured in head-fixed mice during quiet waking and locomotion, with no sensory surprise or top-down prediction; the paper establishes a readout relation, not any consequence for sampling allocation.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Rapid variations in pupil size during quiet waking and locomotion are highly correlated with fluctuations in corticopetal noradrenergic and cholinergic axon activity; rapid pupil dilations are tightly associated with phasic noradrenergic axon activity, whereas longer-lasting dilations (e.g. during locomotion) are accompanied by sustained cholinergic axon activity.
mapping.ree_translation: Validates, and bounds, the instrument used by most human evidence for MECH-084. Fast pupil events ~ phasic NA, which is the 'snap' channel; slower pupil state ~ sustained ACh, which is the MECH-083 trace/learning channel. So the claim's NA/ACh division has a physiological correlate in timescale, but pupil-based support for MECH-084 is always confounded with ACh unless the timescale is resolved.
mapping.mapping_caveat: This is a measurement-validity paper; it says nothing about E1/E2 sampling or orienting. The NA-phasic / ACh-sustained split is correlational and in mouse cortex; human pupil-LC coupling is weaker and less direct.
mapping.source_context: Head-fixed awake mice; two-photon calcium imaging of noradrenergic and cholinergic axons in dorsal cortex with simultaneous pupillometry, quiet waking and locomotion.

confidence_components.notes: Nat Commun, direct axon imaging. Low mapping because it is an instrument-validity result, but it matters for how much weight the pupil entries in this pull can carry.
